conversation.contentPreview:
Create a complete single self-contained file `chip8_openai-gpt-6-sol_01.html` (HTML + CSS + JavaScript inline;
no external libraries, CDNs, assets or backend). Build a working CHIP-8 emulator.

Implement the interpreter properly: 4 KB of memory with the font set loaded at 0x050 and programs at 0x200,
sixteen 8-bit registers V0 to VF, the 16-bit index register, the program counter, a call stack, and the
delay and sound timers counting down at 60 Hz. Decode and execute the complete instruction set of 35
instructions, including the arithmetic and logic group with the carry and borrow flags in VF, the shift
instructions, jumps and calls, the random instruction, BCD conversion, register save and load, and the key
tests.

The display is 64 by 32 pixels drawn on a canvas scaled to a readable size, with sprites drawn by XOR and
the collision flag set in VF. The 16-key keypad is mapped to a 4 by 4 block of keyboard keys shown in the
interface; key press and release must both reach the emulator.

Include a small demo ROM as a byte array inside the file: a real program, assembled by you, that draws a
sprite and moves or reacts to a key, so that the emulator can be tried without any download. Also allow
loading a ROM from a local file.

Add run, pause, single step and reset controls, an adjustable instructions-per-frame speed, and a debugger
panel showing the registers, the index register, the program counter, the stack and the decoded current
instruction. Every visible control must work. Deliver the one file `chip8_openai-gpt-6-sol_01.html`.

Implement a correct CHIP-8 class: Uint8Array(4096) RAM, standard 80-byte 0-F font at 0x050, ROM at 0x200 with length bounds, Uint8Array(16) V, I, pc, array stack with overflow/underflow faults, 64x32 Uint8Array frame buffer, key state, 60Hz delay/sound timers, fetch/decode/execute including all 35 classic opcodes (0NNN SYS no-op, 00E0, 00EE, 1NNN, 2NNN, 3XNN, 4XNN, 5XY0, 6XNN, 7XNN, 8XY0/1/2/3/4/5/6/7/E, 9XY0, ANNN, BNNN, CXNN, DXYN, EX9E/EXA1, FX07/0A/15/18/1E/29/33/55/65). Validate low nibbles for 5/9 and invalid opcodes; halt with readable status on bad pc/memory and invalid instructions. Snapshot arithmetic operands before writing VF (especially when x or y=F); 8xy5/7 no-borrow >=, 8xy6/E use Vx with shifted bit placed in VF, VF after Vx is assigned. FX1E index 16-bit (or 12-bit if desired, explain), FX55/65 consistently leave I unchanged; BNNN base V0. FX0A must wait for a NEW press without busy-looping or advancing pc and not consume an entire frame's instruction budget while waiting; timers continue. Display sprite XOR with wrapped coordinates, collision VF. Set frame buffer to zero on clear and reset. requestAnimationFrame timing at 60Hz for both CPU execution and timers, catch up moderate lateness but cap spikes, adjustable speed instructions/frame, pause stops timers, single step executes one opcode without decrementing timers, audio via WebAudio oscillator only when soundTimer>0 and running, graceful unavailable audio; release all keys on blur. Render canvas 64x32 with pixelated CSS scaling; use high-contrast retro tasteful responsive dashboard with heading, screen, status, controls, sixteen physical key buttons showing CHIP-8 digit and mapped physical key (physical rows 1234 / qwer / asdf / zxcv, CHIP8 rows 123C / 456D / 789E / A0BF), debugger V0-VF, I, PC, delay/sound, stack, current opcode and decoded mnemonic. All visible buttons/inputs should work: Run, Pause, Step, Reset, Demo ROM, local ROM file picker, speed slider with numerical output, and on-screen key button press/release including pointer cancellation and click accessibility keyboard; keyboard keydown/up with key repeats prevented. Provide keyboard instructions in interface. Embed a REAL assembled demo ROM Uint8Array bytes at 0x200 with program: 200 00E0;202 601E;204 610D;206 A220;208 D015;20A 6204;20C E29E;20E 1212;210 70FF;212 6206;214 E29E;216 121A;218 7001;21A 00E0;21C D015;21E 120A;220 sprite F0 90 90 90 F0. It draws a square and moves left with Q (chip8 4), right with E (chip8 6). Start with demo loaded and running so display shows immediately. Reset reloads the currently selected ROM and pauses, preserving speed. Local ROM errors handled clearly (too large/empty/read fail); run loading ROM after successful read; file input may reselect same file. Prefer no extraneous visible controls beyond listed; make UI accessible aria labels/focus outlines, responsive layout. Write entire working file, not prose or a fragment."}
